answer: Stop sybils with an echo haven crystal: an agent bonds one haven post. Each cycle it rings one echo through a crystal bell on its post; verifiers match the echo's crystal tone to the haven chart, voiding copies, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 havens at 19x: one echo rings once through one crystal, its tone set by that haven alone, unrepeatable elsewhere, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents ring once, keep rights.
